plan.client_failure_rule: client crash or short output is data: the missing trials are imputed and the block continues; only server death, missing server stats or a client that could not be executed (rc 126/127) retry the block

plan.imputation: mean_planned_imputed_ms counts every planned trial; failed or missing trials (client crash, short output) are imputed at the client timeout 10000 ms
plan.join_rule: per m4L3 segment: client rows i = 0..n-1 complete and in order; server new connections count == rows; every connection has first_rx_ns > 0; consecutive first_rx_ns gaps >= the client gap 50 ms; conn_acct_dropped and conn_acct_alias_conflicts are 0 in that segment; then the k-th connection by first_rx_ns is client row k (the client opens one connection at a time)
plan.one_rtt_rule: ok and hct_ms < 1.5*rtt_ms + 8*pre_bytes/(1000*rate_mbps) with the sealed nominal pre_bytes = lead*1331 + 2*1280 (PROTOCOL_stage0.md section 6); one_rtt_rate_row_bytes repeats the test with per-trial pre_bytes = first_flight_bytes + first_flight_lead_dgrams * (first_flight_parity_bytes / first_flight_parity_dgrams)
plan.rotation: cyclic Latin as in stage 0: block b runs arms[b mod A:] + arms[:b mod A]
plan.server_lifecycle: both servers start fresh at the first block run and after an infrastructure retry
